_comment: This file exists ONLY so wrangler treats this directory as the project root.
Without it, wrangler walks up to the nearest package.json (packages/elephant)
and resolves wrangler.toml relative to THAT, failing with a misleading
It is deliberately dependency-free. The root package.json globs 'packages/*'

nothing here is touched by the root resolutions that pin typescript ~4.6.4
